text:
</sub>  Precommit the cohort cutoff before observing results

Recording the cutoff only before adjudication still permits outcome-aware cohort selection because every included sweep pass has already completed and its findings are visible. An operator can inspect twelve completed reviews, choose a cutoff that includes the first ten favorable ones, and exclude later unfavorable results while satisfying this rule. The new cutoff language therefore does not fully close the selection-bias path identified earlier; require the cutoff or deterministic sampling window to be fixed before the eligible pass results are observed.
